name: Dolls Kill

prices.note: Newest 1,000 products of the tops feed: 844 tops, only 9 regular-price and in stock (363 marked down, 472 sold out). Default-order feed (first 4,000, mostly 2023 listings) gave 11 at $29–$79 after dropping sold-out items. Multi-brand: house labels plus third-party brands. Low: Pastel Pop Criss-Cross Top $29; high: Moto Dickini Top $79. Regular price = in stock, no variant with compare_at_price above price, no sale/markdown/clearance tag; non-top items (jackets, bottoms, dresses, sets, knitwear, hoodies, men's) excluded by title/product type.

notes: Retailer: sells third-party labels (Demonia, Ed Hardy, Von Dutch, Koi Footwear...) alongside ®-marked house labels (Club Exx, Current Mood, Widow...).
Has its own category 'Women's Streetwear Clothing' (/collections/mia-sexy-streetwear) and a 'Plus Size Women's Streetwear' collection (WebSearch listing).
Founded 2011 by Shoddy Lynn and Bobby Farahi, HQ San Francisco (Wikipedia infobox, citing GeekWire). Wikipedia names no current parent.
Returns are issued as gift cards only ('All returns are issued gift cards').
Prices are null: collection pages render no products or prices to WebFetch (JS).

2026-10-29: its Jeans collection (products.json pages 1, 3 and 4; page 2 returned HTTP 500) lists 18 Jaded London jeans at $80–$108 among 750 products, so Dolls Kill is a stockist of Jaded London, not an alternative to it. Its jeans category is used as co_stocked evidence for other brands on the jaded-london page.
